book_title: Anabasis: The 1960 Nobel Laureate's Poetry--Definitive Bilingual Edition Translated by T. S. Eliot
author: Saint-John Perse
book_description: This internationally famous poem by the 1960 Nobel laureate was introduced to English-language readers in this translation by T. S. Eliot. In this definitive edition, French and English texts appear on facing pages. Preface by T. S. Eliot.
